Right from the year 2022, this matter underwent several adjournments to bring the LR's of the deceased appellant No.2 on record and the appellant had not taken any steps.
On 05.12.2023, when the matter came up before this Court, there was no representation on behalf of the appellants.
Hence, the matter was directed to be NC: 2023:KHC:46205 listed for dismissal.
Today also, there is no representation on behalf of the appellants.
2. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
